title: Quality
description: Quality as a design consideration that every design shall address (4.2). Generic framework content.
guidance: Answer each item for the review stage. A No needs an Action, a Risk or a justification approved by the Discipline Lead (4.5). Items are Draft starter content for review.

items.question: Are quality-critical characteristics of the installation identified?
Are inspection needs identified for the proposed processes?
Are lessons learned from similar installations reviewed?
Are key characteristics marked for control?
Are inspection methods and access defined?
Are supplier quality requirements identified for bought-in items?
Are inspection and acceptance criteria stated on the released definitions?
Are key characteristics and their measurement methods defined?
Are non-conformance reporting routes defined for the installation?

draft_note: Starter checklist items, Draft: to be reviewed with the framework owner before Framework v1.0 release.
